This decrepit '''citadel''' was a large structure located on [[Kohlma]], a burial moon orbiting [[Bogden/Legends|Bogden]].<ref name="DB-Vosa, Komari">{{DB|character|komarivosa|Vosa, Komari}}</ref> It was from here that [[Komari Vosa]] led the notorious [[Bando Gora/Legends|Bando Gora]] cult.
